content.text: Fixed: emphasis inside a rejected reference link now renders, so `[foo *bar [baz](/url) qux*][ref]` gives `[foo bar baz qux]ref`. All 1787 spec tests and the 45 unit tests pass after a rebuild. **Cause:** `inlineTokens` in `src/Lexer.ts` replaces every defined reference link with a block of `a` characters before looking for emphasis. It masked the whole outer link, including the inner link and the `*…*` inside it. The outer link is then rejected, because links can't nest. Its text is scanned again, but the `*` closer is still hidden by the mask, so the asterisks stayed as literal text. **Fix:** I made the masking recursive in `src/Lexer.ts`. If a non-image reference link contains another link (inline or reference) in its text, only the inner links are masked and the outer brackets stay visible. Images are unchanged, since their text is flattened into the alt attribute and can still contain links. I checked `*`, `_`, `**`, an inline inner link and a reference inner link. A first attempt also searched the trailing `[label]` and broke example 534 (`*[foo*][ref]`), so I limited the search to the link text. **Spec files:** CommonMark example 533 was marked `shouldFail` in `test/specs/commonmark/commonmark.0.31.2.json` and `test/specs/gfm/commonmark.0.31.2.json`. It passes now, so I removed that flag from both. I did not add a separate test for the `_` and `**` variants.
